description: This PHP class defines EmployeeSearchFilterParams, a data transfer object (DTO) for filtering employee search results in the OrangeHRM system. It includes properties for various search criteria, constants for allowed sort fields and inclusion options, and methods for setting and getting these properties, with validation for includeEmployees.

classes.name: EmployeeSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for specifying search filters for employee queries in OrangeHRM, including properties for employee attributes and search options.

methods.name: getIncludeEmployees
methods.description: Returns the current includeEmployees filter value.

methods.name: setIncludeEmployees
methods.description: Sets the includeEmployees filter value, validating against allowed options.

methods.name: getEmpStatusId
methods.description: Returns the employment status ID filter.

methods.name: setEmpStatusId
methods.description: Sets the employment status ID filter.

methods.name: getJobTitleId
methods.description: Returns the job title ID filter.

methods.name: setJobTitleId
methods.description: Sets the job title ID filter.

methods.name: getSupervisorEmpNumbers
methods.description: Returns the supervisor employee numbers filter.

methods.name: setSupervisorEmpNumbers
methods.description: Sets the supervisor employee numbers filter.
